flows.info:
Exercises the node-red-contrib-gx-ble palette nodes over HTTP:
GET /bgx/devices — array-mode scan, list classified devices
GET /bgx/status?mac=XX:XX:.. — read status of one device
GET /bgx/seen — sightings collected from the last stream-mode scan (trigger via the inject)
Managed by the bgx repo.
